name: Greco Counter-Attack — Main Line
description: The sharp counter-gambit in the Two Knights Defense. Black strikes at White's knight on g5 with 4...d5, sacrificing the d-pawn for fierce counter-play.

lines.name: Greco Counter-Attack
lines.description: Black sacrifices the d-pawn with 4...d5 to disrupt White's attacking knight on g5 and seize counter-play. White grabs the pawn and concedes the center; Black obtains the bishop pair and active pieces. Both sides castle kingside by move 11.
